tasks.name: 사용자 저장 영상 모델 전환
tasks.summary: Replaced the active saved-drama entity with UserSavedVideo, added a TypeORM createTable migration with a MySQL CHECK SQL statement and a QueryBuilder count guard for rollback, updated entity and migration unit tests, and renamed/synchronized the data-model docs. Checks passed: lint; full back test (106 unit tests, 132 API requests, 274 assertions, 0 failures); build. Read-only DB inspection found both user_saved_dramas and user_saved_videos empty; the synchronized target table lacks the CHECK. The new migration was not applied because AddAuthSessions20261028000000 is also pending and migration:run would apply unrelated schema changes. The legacy entity file was moved out of its old path using apply_patch because DeleteFile failed.
